Key evidence includes the transaction originating from a new device profile behind an anonymous proxy, which shares exact markers with 28 cards in a 60-day window where 4 closed cases were confirmed fraud and all 8 most similar closed cases were confirmed fraud. The system automatically created the case, monitored connected cards, and escalated to an analyst, while awaiting human approval to block the card and file a report.

sar.narrative: Customer C06650, holder of card C06650-K2, is the subject of this report. Between 2016-11-30 17:48 and 2016-11-30 17:48, 1 transaction(s) totalling $97.61 were made on the card online from device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080' through an anonymous proxy: $97.61 (3500876, 2016-11-30 17:48). The same device profile was used on 27 other customers' cards in the same period (C01289-K1, C01996-K2, C02910-K1, C02975-K1, C03676-K2, C04108-K2, C04274-K1, C05448-K2...), most of them behind anonymous proxies and each time as a new device, indicating a common actor. The activity is suspicious because: Device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080' was used by 28 cards in a 60-day window around the alert; 28 of them behind an anonymous/hidden proxy and 28 flagged as a New device. 4 closed case(s) on cards that used this profile were confirmed fraud, 4 of them recorded as an undocumented pattern. It closely resembles earlier confirmed fraud cases CC-2985, CC-2649, CC-0849. The bank has recommended blocking and reissuing the card, placed linked cards under monitoring where applicable, and retains the transaction, device and investigation records as supporting documentation.
